Name: Undying Frame, Minor
Information:
**Undying Frame**

This deceased frame unit is the remains of one or more frame units who met a grizzly end in combat, who then became possessed by the last will and anguish of their pilots, or—in rarer cases—the undying frame is a frame unit with a corrupt sense of self that led to violent case of self-possession. They act as though piloted by a dark spirit, but their mechanical functions have all but ceased. The undying frame will act out against anything it could perceive to be a threat except its own kind, and consumes chunks of other similar frame units it finds or defeats.

**Infectious Spirit.** The malfunction controlling these units can spread from one to another, though it cannot kill another frame unit on its own. By attempting to infect another, it cripples and shuts down a frame unit’s ability to operate, sometimes leading to them hanging lifelessly.

**Jenvaj’s Influence.** Some undying frames are the result of the eidolic deity Jenvaj worming its way into their systems and puppeting them from the inside, then using them to spread its influence. These individuals are monstrosities instead of undead, and have a more mutated appearance.

**Converting a Frame Unit**

If you wish to turn another frame unit into an undying frame, you can make the following alterations to it do so:

• The unit gains the Regeneration/Regen trait, regaining a number of points each turn equal to half its challenge rating (rounded up) + 5.
• The frame unit gains the undead creature type.
• The frame unit’s alignment becomes neutral evil.
• The frame unit gains blindsight out to 60 feet, or their existing blindsight increases by 60 feet.
• Any cold, radiant, or lightning damage the unit would deal becomes force damage.
• The frame unit gains the System Infection (1/Rest) action described below.

**System Infection (1/Rest) (Action).** The undying frame chooses a number of non-undead frame units it can see within 120 feet, whom it attempts to infiltrate the systems of. Each one must make an Intelligence saving throw (DC 8 + Constitution modifier + proficiency bonus). On a failure, they are infected with a virus that attempts to possess their systems, and is stunned for 1 minute. During this time, they can repeat the saving throw each time they take damage and at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

The undying frame can target a number of units equal to its proficiency bonus.

**Quote**

“Death comes even to machines. So to does undeath. I don’t care for it. I consider it the duty of any living being to destroy these perversions if it is within their power.”

actions.name: DGR Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Dead Space Rifle
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d12 + 2) force damage.

actions.name: System Infection (1/Rest)
actions.description: The undying frame chooses up to three other non-undead frame units it can see within 120 feet, whom it attempts to infiltrate the systems of. Each one must make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, they are infected with a virus that attempts to possess their systems, and are stunned for 1 minute. During this time, they can repeat the saving throw each time they take damage and at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Chain Tendrils
bonus_actions.description: Two creatures the undying frame can see within 30 feet of it are attacked by a set of possessed metal tendrils, and must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw (which automatically succeeds if it is Tremendous or larger). On a failure, the target takes 2d10 slashing damage and the undying frame may move it into an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where the target was.

bonus_actions.name: Death Pellets
bonus_actions.description: The undying frame chooses two creatures it can see within 60 feet, who each are assailed by a series of small metallic darts. Each target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (1d12) piercing damage and 6 (1d10) necrotic damage on a failure.
